What pass requires: Eligibility, exposure assignment, covariate assessment, follow-up, and outcome ascertainment align at a defensible time zero.
Confounders are selected using clinical knowledge or a DAG; mediators, colliders, post-index, and post-outcome variables are excluded.
Estimand, PS or outcome model, matching/weighting settings, common support, trimming, discarded records, seed, and SMD diagnostics are reported.
Missing-data, alternative design/model, negative-control or unmeasured-confounding analyses map to explicit threats.
Notes: Use E-values only for compatible effect measures.
